name: clde-cube-headless
description: Cube semantic layer over iDempiere. The live project is cube/; legacy-0.28/ holds the pre-migration reference.
comment: This file used to be the Cube 0.28.19 project scaffold, carrying
It was never updated after the move to Cube 1.7.19 and was misleading in two
ways: it advertised a 0.28 template for a 1.7.19 runtime, and `npm run dev`
named a binary that is not installed here - there is no root node_modules and
no lock file, so it could only ever have failed.
cube/       the live Cube 1.7.19 project - model, config, compose, scripts
legacy-0.28/ the 0.28 model and config, READ ONLY, migration reference
The 0.28 cube.js and schema/ used to sit at this level, where a server started
here would have loaded them instead of cube/cube.js. They now live in legacy-0.28/.

scripts.dev: echo 'Run from cube/: cd cube && docker compose up -d' && exit 1
